description_for_human: Universal credential-injecting proxy: one user approval per OAuth provider, then agents call any API of that provider without ever seeing tokens.
description_for_model: CNothing v4 MCP. Agent NEVER receives OAuth tokens, API keys, or client secrets. Flow: list_providers -> request_access (returns approval_url) -> human approves once in browser -> get_access_status (returns grant_id) -> proxy_request for any https API on the granted hosts. Authorization headers are injected server-side; responses are redacted.

auth.instructions: Every tool call requires agent_access_token (issued by the platform operator via POST /v4/agents/register). Human OAuth consent happens in the browser at approval_url only.
